# ZeroDust

> Recover stranded native gas by emptying a chain's balance to exactly zero.

You cannot transfer 100% of a native gas token. Paying for the transfer consumes
the token you are transferring, so a remainder is always left behind and becomes
unrecoverable. ZeroDust removes that remainder: it moves the entire balance
(ETH, BNB, POL, etc.) off a chain and leaves exactly zero, to any address on the
same or a different chain, via a relayer that fronts the gas.

Use it when someone cannot send their full balance, has small amounts scattered
across many chains, or wants to close out, wind down or fully exit a chain.

## How it works

1. Sign an EIP-7702 authorization (delegates your EOA temporarily)
2. Sign an EIP-712 sweep intent (specifies destination and fee limits)
3. ZeroDust's relayer executes the sweep atomically
4. Balance goes to exactly zero, funds arrive at your destination
5. Delegation is automatically revoked after the sweep

## Supported chains

25 mainnet chains: Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Gnosis, Unichain, Polygon,
Sonic, X Layer, Fraxtal, World Chain, Sei, Story, Soneium, Mantle, Superseed,
Base, Plasma, Mode, Arbitrum, Celo, Ink, BOB, Berachain, Scroll, and Zora.

`GET https://api.zerodust.xyz/chains` is the authoritative list. Prefer it over
this one, which is a snapshot.

There are no testnet chains. `GET /chains?testnet=true` returns an empty list, so
there is no testnet environment to integrate against - use the `dryRun` option
described below instead.

## Fee structure

- Free tier: No service fee for sweeps under $1
- Standard: 1% service fee (min $0.05, max $0.50)
- Gas: Paid by relayer, reimbursed from swept amount

## Integration packages

- [@zerodust/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zerodust/sdk): TypeScript SDK for wallets and apps
- [@zerodust/mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zerodust/mcp-server): MCP server for Claude and AI agents
- [@zerodust/langchain](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zerodust/langchain): LangChain.js tools
- [@zerodust/ai-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zerodust/ai-sdk): Vercel AI SDK tools

## API

Base URL: https://api.zerodust.xyz

### Endpoints

- GET /chains - List supported chains
- GET /balances/:address - Get balances across all chains for an address
- GET /quote?fromChainId=&toChainId=&userAddress=&destination= - Get a sweep quote
- POST /authorization - Create EIP-712 typed data for signing (body: { quoteId })
- POST /sweep - Submit a signed sweep (body: { quoteId, signature, eip7702Authorization })
- GET /sweep/:sweepId - Get sweep status
- GET /sweeps/:address - List sweeps for an address

### Authentication

Optional API key via X-API-Key header for higher rate limits.

## SDK Quick Start

```typescript
import { ZeroDust } from '@zerodust/sdk';

const zerodust = new ZeroDust({ environment: 'mainnet' });
const balances = await zerodust.getBalances('0xYourAddress...');
```

## AI Agent Quick Start

```typescript
import { createAgentFromPrivateKey } from '@zerodust/sdk';

const agent = createAgentFromPrivateKey('0xPrivateKey...', {
  environment: 'mainnet',
});

const result = await agent.sweep({
  fromChainId: 42161,
  toChainId: 8453,
  destination: '0xDestination...',
});
```

## Trying it without moving funds

Every sweep in the SDK and the MCP server accepts a dry run. It fetches a real
quote, produces all three real signatures, then stops before submitting. Nothing
is broadcast and no balance changes.

```typescript
const check = await agent.sweep(
  { fromChainId: 42161, toChainId: 8453 },
  { dryRun: true }
);
check.dryRun;   // true
check.sweepId;  // undefined - nothing was submitted
```

## MCP Server

Hosted, nothing to install. Point any MCP client at this URL:

```
https://api.zerodust.xyz/mcp
```

Read-only, because it holds no keys. Tools: `zerodust_get_chains`,
`zerodust_get_balances`, `zerodust_get_quote`, `zerodust_get_sweep_status`,
`zerodust_list_sweeps`, `zerodust_register_api_key`, `zerodust_info`.

Local, can sweep, because the key stays on your machine:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zerodust": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@zerodust/mcp-server"]
    }
  }
}
```

Same tool names, plus `zerodust_sweep`, `zerodust_sweep_all` and
`zerodust_get_agent_address`. Sweeping requires `ZERODUST_ALLOW_EXECUTE=true`
and a signing key, which may be a signer module returning a viem LocalAccount
(Turnkey, Privy, KMS), an encrypted V3 keystore, a key file, or an inline key.

## Self-service credentials

An agent can issue itself an API key with no human signup step:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.zerodust.xyz/agent/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "my-agent", "agentId": "my-agent-1"}'
# -> { "apiKey": "zd_...", "rateLimits": { "perMinute": 300, "daily": 1000 } }
```

The read endpoints work without a key; this only raises rate limits.
